title: The chalk
logline: The face with chalk on it: a mustache, a crown, a child's hand. Gully's son, eleven, at the page's edge with the chalk, and rain starting. The page draws the town treating its monument the way the town does.

panels.composition: The carved stone face in grass with a chalk mustache and crown drawn on it, a boy of eleven at the frame's edge holding chalk, the first drops of rain on the stone.
